select d.dept_name as deptName, p.post_name as postName, u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.user_phone as userPhone, u.user_rank as userRank from hub_user_role r join hub_user u on r.user_id = u.user_id left join hub_user_dept ud on u.user_id = ud.user_id and ud.is_default = 1 left join hub_dept d on ud.dept_id = d.dept_id left join hub_post p on ud.post_id = p.post_id where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.role_id = #{query.roleId}
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and u.user_phone like concat('%', #{query.userPhone}, '%')
group by u.user_id, d.dept_name, p.post_name, u.user_name, u.user_phone, u.user_rank

select d.dept_name as deptName, p.post_name as postName, u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.user_phone as userPhone, u.user_rank as userRank from hub_user u left join hub_user_dept ud on u.user_id = ud.user_id and ud.is_default = 1 left join hub_dept d on ud.dept_id = d.dept_id left join hub_post p on ud.post_id = p.post_id where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and u.user_id not in ( select user_id from hub_user_role where role_id = #{query.roleId} )
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and u.user_phone like concat('%', #{query.userPhone}, '%')
group by u.user_id, d.dept_name, p.post_name, u.user_name, u.user_phone, u.user_rank
